# TypeScript API reference

This inventory is generated from the package's public export surface.
Unknown or internal symbols are deliberately excluded.

- [`AccessToken`](https://github.com/datalayer/personal-agent-protocol/blob/main/src/sessions.ts) — Interface; entry `.`. An access token for one account, kept beside what the SDK knows of it (§4.5).
